G0.title: Coordinated Motion at Rapid Rate
G0.description: Rapid traverse to the programmed point at maximum rapid rate (or slower). Typically used for positioning. Path may be rounded at direction changes depending on trajectory settings. Axis words are optional; omitted axes keep their current position.
G0.summary: Positions all programmed axes in one rapid move at traverse speed.
G0.syntax: G0 (X, Y, Z, A, B, C, U, V, W — optional)

related.hint: Machine coordinates (non-modal, same line as G0/G1)

G1.title: Coordinated Motion at Feed Rate
G1.description: Straight-line motion at the current feed rate. Requires a feed rate to have been set (F word). Used for cutting and any feed-rate-controlled motion.
G1.summary: Moves in a straight line at the current feed rate.

related.hint: Feed per revolution (not for threading — use G33/G76)

G2.title: Clockwise Helical Motion at Feed Rate
G2.description: Circular or helical arc clockwise (as viewed from the positive end of the axis perpendicular to the active plane). Use center format (I, J, K) or radius format (R). Requires feed rate. Plane is selected with G17–G19.
G2.summary: Helical or circular arc clockwise in the active plane at feed rate.
G2.syntax: G2 (X, Y, Z, I, J, P, F) or G2 (X, Y, Z, R, P, F)

G3.title: Counterclockwise Helical Motion at Feed Rate
G3.description: Circular or helical arc counterclockwise (as viewed from the positive end of the axis perpendicular to the active plane). Same parameters as G2 but opposite arc direction.
G3.summary: Helical or circular arc counterclockwise in the active plane at feed rate.
G3.syntax: G3 (X, Y, Z, I, J, P, F) or G3 (X, Y, Z, R, P, F)

G4.title: Dwell
G4.description: Pauses all axes for P seconds (floating point). Does not affect spindle, coolant, or I/O.
G4.summary: Dwells with all axes stopped for the given time.

G5.title: Cubic Spline
G5.description: Creates a cubic B-spline in the XY plane. First segment requires I, J; P and Q are required on every G5 block. Active plane must be G17.
G5.summary: Cuts a cubic B-spline segment in the XY plane.
G5.syntax: G5 X Y I J P Q

G5.1.title: Quadratic B-Spline
G5.1.description: Creates a quadratic B-spline in the XY plane using X, Y, I, and J. Active plane must be G17.
G5.1.summary: Cuts a quadratic B-spline in the XY plane.

G5.2.title: NURBS — Open Block
G5.2.description: Opens a NURBS data block (experimental). Control points and weights follow until G5.3 closes the block.

G5.3.title: NURBS — Close Block
G5.3.description: Closes the NURBS block opened with G5.2.
G5.3.summary: Closes the NURBS block opened with G5.2.

G7.title: Lathe Diameter Mode
G7.description: X moves on a lathe are interpreted in diameter: e.g. X1 moves the tool to 0.5 from center for a 1" diameter.
G7.summary: Interprets lathe X moves as diameter.

G8.title: Lathe Radius Mode
G8.description: X moves on a lathe are interpreted as radius from center. Default at power-up.
G8.summary: Interprets lathe X moves as radius from center.

G10.title: Setup — Tool Table / Coordinates
G10.description: Data setting: G10 L0 reloads tool table; L1/L10/L11 set tool table entries; L2/L20 set coordinate system origins (G54–G59.3). L word selects the operation.
G10.summary: Writes tool table or coordinate system data; L selects the operation.

G17.title: Plane Select — XY
G17.description: Selects the XY plane for arcs and canned cycles; circular motion is about the Z axis.
G17.summary: Selects the XY plane for arcs and canned cycles.

G18.title: Plane Select — ZX
G18.description: Selects the ZX plane; circular motion is about the Y axis.
G18.summary: Selects the ZX plane for arcs and canned cycles.

G19.title: Plane Select — YZ
G19.description: Selects the YZ plane; circular motion is about the X axis.
G19.summary: Selects the YZ plane for arcs and canned cycles.

G17.1.title: Plane Select — UV
G17.1.description: Selects the UV plane (additional coordinate triplet). Arcs are not supported in UVW family planes.

G18.1.title: Plane Select — WU
G18.1.description: Selects the WU plane. Arcs are not supported.

G19.1.title: Plane Select — VW
G19.1.description: Selects the VW plane. Arcs are not supported.

G20.title: Units — Inches
G20.description: Length units are inches for subsequent G-code.

G21.title: Units — Millimeters
G21.description: Length units are millimeters for subsequent G-code.

G28.title: Go to Predefined Position (G28)
G28.description: Rapid move to stored position in parameters 5161–5169 (machine coordinates), optionally via an intermediate point if axes are programmed. Requires homing and G28.1 to store positions.
G28.summary: Rapids via optional axes to the stored machine G28 position.
G28.syntax: G28 (X, Y, Z, … optional intermediate) or G28

G28.1.title: Store G28 Position
G28.1.description: Stores the current absolute machine position into G28 reference parameters.
G28.1.summary: Stores the current absolute position as the G28 reference.

G30.title: Go to Predefined Position (G30)
G30.description: Same idea as G28 but uses parameters 5181–5189. May be used for tool change position if configured in INI.
G30.summary: Rapids via optional axes to the stored machine G30 position.
G30.syntax: G30 (X, Y, Z, … optional intermediate) or G30

G30.1.title: Store G30 Position
G30.1.description: Stores the current absolute machine position into G30 reference parameters.
G30.1.summary: Stores the current absolute position as the G30 reference.

G33.title: Spindle-Synchronized Motion
G33.description: Linear motion synchronized to spindle rotation; K is distance per revolution. Requires spindle index, at-speed, and revs feedback per integrator manual.
G33.summary: Moves linearly in sync with spindle rotation; K is distance per revolution.

G33.1.title: Rigid Tapping
G33.1.description: Tapping cycle with synchronized Z motion and spindle reversal; returns to the start position. For Z-only tapping, preposition XY and use only Z on the G33.1 line.
G33.1.summary: Rigid tapping: synchronized in-feed, spindle reverse, and return.

related.hint: Spindle sync without tap retract cycle

G38.2.title: Probe — Toward Workpiece, Error on Failure
G38.2.description: Linear probe move at feed rate; stops on probe contact. Signals error if contact is not made. Sets parameters #5061–#5069 and #5070.
G38.2.summary: Probes in a straight line toward the part and errors if no trip.

related.hint: Probe toward part, no error if no trip

G38.3.title: Probe — Toward Workpiece, No Error on Failure
G38.3.description: Like G38.2 but does not signal an error if the probe does not trip.
G38.3.summary: Probes toward the part without error if the probe does not trip.

related.hint: Probe toward part, error if no trip

G38.4.title: Probe — Away from Workpiece, Error on Failure
G38.4.description: Probe move away until loss of contact; errors if the target state is not reached.
G38.4.summary: Probes away from the part and errors if contact is not lost.

G38.5.title: Probe — Away from Workpiece, No Error on Failure
G38.5.description: Like G38.4 without error signaling on failure.
G38.5.summary: Probes away from the part without error if contact is not lost.

G40.title: Cancel Cutter Compensation
G40.description: Turns off cutter radius compensation. After G40 the next move must be linear and longer than the tool diameter.

related.hint: Cutter radius comp left of path

G41.title: Cutter Compensation — Left
G41.description: Offsets the tool path to the left of the programmed path (viewed from +Z in the XY plane). Optional D word selects tool number for radius.
G41.summary: Offsets the path to the left of the programmed line (active plane).

related.hint: Comp off (next move linear, longer than tool dia.)

G42.title: Cutter Compensation — Right
G42.description: Offsets the tool path to the right of the programmed path. Optional D word selects tool number for radius.
G42.summary: Offsets the path to the right of the programmed line (active plane).

G41.1.title: Dynamic Cutter Compensation — Left
G41.1.description: Like G41 but tool diameter is given with D (and optional L orientation on lathe).
G41.1.summary: Cutter comp left with programmed diameter D (optional L on lathe).

G42.1.title: Dynamic Cutter Compensation — Right
G42.1.description: Like G42 with programmed cutter diameter D.
G42.1.summary: Cutter comp right with programmed diameter D (optional L on lathe).

G43.title: Tool Length Offset
G43.description: Applies tool length compensation from the tool table. G43 Hn selects tool n; G43 alone uses the current tool after T/M6. Does not cause motion.
G43.summary: Applies tool length offset from the tool table (no motion).

related.hint: Set tool number only — then G43

G43.1.title: Dynamic Tool Length Offset
G43.1.description: Replaces current offset values with the programmed axis words. Does not write the tool table. No motion on the G43.1 line.
G43.1.summary: Replaces dynamic tool length offsets with axis values (no motion).

G43.2.title: Additional Tool Length Offset
G43.2.description: Adds another tool’s offsets (G43.2 Hn) or adds axis values to the current combined offset. Can be called repeatedly to sum offsets.
G43.2.summary: Adds another tool table offset or extra axis offsets (no motion).

G52.title: Local Coordinate System Offset
G52.description: Temporary offset in the current work coordinate system (G54–G59.3). See Local and Global Offsets in the manual for interaction with G92.
G52.summary: Sets a temporary local offset in the current work system.

related.hint: Base WCS (G52 is local shift on top)
Global offset — see manual for interaction

G53.title: Move in Machine Coordinates
G53.description: Non-modal: use on the same line as G0/G1 to move in machine coordinates. Must be programmed on each line that needs it.
G53.summary: Moves in machine coordinates on this line (with G0/G1).

related.hint: G53 non-modal on same line as G0 or G1

G61.title: Exact Path Mode
G61.description: Follows the programmed path exactly; may slow or stop between segments. Collinear consecutive moves may not stop.
G61.summary: Exact path mode: follows programmed points (may slow at corners).

G61.1.title: Exact Stop Mode
G61.1.description: Full stop at the end of each programmed segment.
G61.1.summary: Exact stop mode: full stop at each segment end.

related.hint: Exact path without stop at every corner

G64.title: Path Blending / Tolerance
G64.description: Blends corners for speed. Optional P (deviation tolerance) and Q (naive CAM tolerance) tune accuracy vs. performance.
G64.summary: Path blending; optional P and Q control tolerance and naive-CAM merge.

G70.title: Lathe Finishing Cycle
G70.description: Finishing pass along a profile defined in subroutine Q, after G71/G72 roughing. Requires ZX plane and monotonic profile.
G70.summary: Finishing pass along subroutine Q after G71/G72 roughing (lathe).
G70.syntax: G70 Q (X, Z, D, E, P)

G71.title: Lathe Roughing Cycle — Z Axis
G71.description: Roughs along Z using a profile subroutine Q. Variants G71.1 (no pockets) and G71.2 (continuation after G71.1).
G71.summary: Z-direction roughing cycle using profile subroutine Q (lathe).
G71.syntax: G71 Q (X, Z, D, I, R)

G71.1.title: Lathe Roughing — G71.1
G71.1.description: G71 variant that does not cut pockets.
G71.1.summary: G71 variant that does not cut pockets.
G71.1.syntax: G71.1 Q (X, Z, D, I, R)

G71.2.title: Lathe Roughing — G71.2
G71.2.description: Continues roughing after G71.1 where it stopped; useful for multi-pocket profiles.
G71.2.summary: Continues G71 roughing after G71.1 stopped.
G71.2.syntax: G71.2 Q (X, Z, D, I, R)

G72.title: Lathe Facing / Roughing — X Axis
G72.description: Facing-style roughing with profile in subroutine Q. Includes G72.1 and G72.2 variants similar to G71.
G72.summary: X-direction (facing) roughing cycle using profile subroutine Q (lathe).
G72.syntax: G72 Q (X, Z, D, I, R)

G72.1.title: Lathe Facing — G72.1
G72.1.summary: G72 variant that does not cut pockets.
G72.1.syntax: G72.1 Q (X, Z, D, I, R)

G72.2.title: Lathe Facing — G72.2
G72.2.summary: Continues G72 roughing after G72.1 stopped.
G72.2.syntax: G72.2 Q (X, Z, D, I, R)

G73.title: Drilling with Chip Breaking
G73.description: Peck drilling with short retracts (chip break). Q is increment along the drill axis; R is retract plane.
G73.summary: Drilling with chip-breaking pecks along the cycle axis.
G73.syntax: G73 (X, Y, Z, R, Q, L)

related.hint: Peck with full retract to R

G74.title: Left-Hand Tapping Cycle with Dwell
G74.description: Floating-tap style cycle (not synchronized motion). Uses F as pitch × spindle speed; dwell P at bottom.
G74.summary: Left-hand floating tap cycle with dwell (not rigid/sync).
G74.syntax: G74 (X, Y, Z, U, V, W, R, L, P, $, F)

G76.title: Multi-Pass Threading Cycle (Lathe)
G76.description: Threading cycle in ZX plane using P, Z, I, J, K, and optional Q, R, H, E, L. Requires spindle encoder/index for synchronization.
G76.summary: Multi-pass lathe threading synchronized to the spindle.
G76.syntax: G76 P Z I J K (R, Q, H, E, L, $)

G80.title: Cancel Canned Cycles
G80.description: Cancels G81–G89 canned cycle modal motion. Any group-1 motion G-code also cancels the cycle.

G81.title: Drilling Cycle
G81.description: Standard drill: rapid to XY, rapid to R, feed to Z, rapid retract per G98/G99.
G81.summary: Drill cycle: feed to Z, then retract per G98/G99.
G81.syntax: G81 (X, Y, Z, U, V, W, R, L)

G82.title: Drilling Cycle with Dwell
G82.description: Like G81 with dwell P at bottom of hole.
G82.summary: Drill cycle with dwell at bottom.
G82.syntax: G82 (X, Y, Z, U, V, W, R, L, P)

G83.title: Peck Drilling Cycle
G83.description: Peck drilling with full retract to R (chip clearing). Q is peck increment.
G83.summary: Peck drill with retract to R for chip clearing.
G83.syntax: G83 (X, Y, Z, U, V, W, R, L, Q)

related.hint: Short chip breaks vs full retract

G84.title: Right-Hand Tapping Cycle with Dwell
G84.description: Floating-tap cycle for right-hand threads; not synchronized rigid tapping.
G84.summary: Right-hand floating tap cycle with dwell (not rigid/sync).
G84.syntax: G84 (X, Y, Z, U, V, W, R, L, P, $, F)

G85.title: Boring Cycle — Feed Out
G85.description: Bore in, feed retract to R (or as documented), then rapid clear.
G85.summary: Bore in at feed, feed retract, then rapid clear.
G85.syntax: G85 (X, Y, Z, U, V, W, R, L)

G86.title: Boring Cycle — Stop Spindle, Rapid Out
G86.description: Bore, dwell, stop spindle, rapid out, restart spindle.
G86.summary: Bore, dwell, stop spindle, rapid out, restart spindle.
G86.syntax: G86 (X, Y, Z, U, V, W, R, L, P, $)

G87.title: Back-Boring Cycle
G87.description: Accepted by the interpreter but not fully implemented; behavior undefined.
G87.summary: Back-boring cycle (accepted; behavior undefined / not implemented).

G88.title: Boring Cycle — Manual Out
G88.description: Accepted but not fully implemented; behavior undefined.
G88.summary: Boring cycle with manual retract (accepted; not fully implemented).

G89.title: Boring Cycle — Dwell, Feed Out
G89.description: Bore with dwell, then feed out.
G89.summary: Bore with dwell at bottom, then feed out.
G89.syntax: G89 (X, Y, Z, U, V, W, R, L, P)

G90.title: Absolute Distance Mode
G90.description: Axis words are absolute positions in the active coordinate system.
G90.summary: Axis words are absolute positions in the active coordinate system.

G91.title: Incremental Distance Mode
G91.description: Axis words are increments from the current position.
G91.summary: Axis words are increments from the current position.

G90.1.title: Absolute Arc Center Offsets
G90.1.description: I, J, K arc centers are absolute in the current coordinate system for G2/G3.
G90.1.summary: Arc center offsets I J K are absolute.

G91.1.title: Incremental Arc Center Offsets
G91.1.description: I, J, K are relative to the arc start (default for arcs).
G91.1.summary: Arc center offsets I J K are incremental from arc start (default).

G92.title: Coordinate System Offset
G92.description: Offsets all origins so the current point becomes the programmed values. Stored in parameters 5211–5219. Use carefully; see G92.1/G92.2 to clear.
G92.summary: Shifts all coordinate origins so the current point matches the given values.
G92.syntax: G92 (X, Y, Z, … — at least one axis)

G92.1.title: Reset G92 Offsets
G92.1.description: Clears G92 offsets and zeros parameters 5211–5219.
G92.1.summary: Clears G92 offsets and zeros the stored parameters.

G92.2.title: Turn Off G92 (Keep Parameters)
G92.2.description: Disables G92 offsets but retains parameter values for later G92.3.
G92.2.summary: Disables G92 offsets but keeps parameter values for G92.3.

G92.3.title: Restore G92 Offsets
G92.3.summary: Restores G92 offsets from saved parameters.

G93.title: Inverse Time Feed Mode
G93.description: F is inverse minutes for the move (each G1/G2/G3 line needs F).
G93.summary: Inverse time: F is minutes⁻¹ for each feed move.

G94.title: Feed Rate — Units per Minute
G94.description: F is length units per minute (or degrees per minute for rotary axes).
G94.summary: Feed rate is length units per minute (or deg/min on rotary axes).

G95.title: Feed Rate — Units per Revolution
G95.description: F is feed per spindle revolution; requires spindle speed-in. Not for threading—use G33/G76.
G95.summary: Feed rate is units per spindle revolution (not for threading).

G96.title: Constant Surface Speed
G96.description: CSS mode on lathe: S is surface speed (ft/min or m/min); D optional max RPM. X0 should be part center.
G96.summary: Constant surface speed on lathe; S is speed, D optional max RPM.

related.hint: Fixed RPM; with G96, S is usually surface speed (see manual)

G97.title: Spindle RPM Mode
G97.description: S is spindle speed in RPM.
G97.summary: Spindle speed S is in RPM.

related.hint: Constant surface speed instead of fixed RPM

G98.title: Canned Cycle — Retract to Initial Z
G98.description: Between canned cycle moves, retract to the Z level in effect when the cycle started (if above R).
G98.summary: Canned cycles retract to the initial Z if it is above R.

G99.title: Canned Cycle — Retract to R Plane
G99.description: Retract to the R word plane after each hole.
G99.summary: Canned cycles retract to the R plane.

M0.title: Program Pause
M0.description: Optional program stop. Resume continues execution at the next line.
M0.summary: Pauses the program until cycle start (optional stop behavior).

M1.title: Optional Stop
M1.description: Pauses only if optional stop is enabled on the control.
M1.summary: Pauses only if the optional-stop switch is on.

M2.title: Program End
M2.description: Ends the program and resets many modal states (G54, G17, G90, G94, G40, G49, M5, M9, etc.).
M2.summary: Ends the program and resets many modal states to defaults.

related.hint: Spindle stop — also applied when M2 ends the program

M30.title: Program End / Rewind
M30.description: Like M2 with pallet/rewind behavior as configured; cycle start runs from the beginning.
M30.summary: Ends the program (pallet/rewind behavior per config); restart from top.

M60.title: Pallet Change Pause
M60.description: Exchange pallets and pause; resume continues at the next line.
M60.summary: Pallet exchange then pause; resume continues on the next line.

M3.title: Spindle On — Clockwise
M3.description: Starts the selected spindle clockwise at the last S speed. Use $ for spindle number on multi-spindle configs.
M3.summary: Starts the selected spindle clockwise at the last S speed.

M4.title: Spindle On — Counterclockwise
M4.description: Starts the selected spindle counterclockwise at the last S speed.
M4.summary: Starts the selected spindle counterclockwise at the last S speed.

M6.title: Tool Change
M6.description: Performs a tool change to the tool selected by T. Does not apply tool length offset—use G43 after M6.
M6.summary: Runs the tool change for the tool last selected with T.

related.hint: Apply length offset after change (select tool with T first)
Set tool number only, no physical change

M9.title: All Coolant Off
M9.summary: Turns off mist and flood coolant.

M19.title: Orient Spindle
M19.description: Positions spindle to angle R with optional direction P and timeout Q. Requires encoder with index.
M19.summary: Orients the spindle to angle R with optional P direction and Q timeout.

M48.title: Enable Feed & Speed Overrides
M48.description: Re-enables feed and spindle override controls.
M48.summary: Enables feed and spindle speed override controls.

M49.title: Disable Feed & Speed Overrides
M49.description: Disables feed and spindle overrides so program F/S are exact.

M50.title: Feed Override Control
M50.description: M50 P1 enables feed override; M50 P0 disables it.
M50.summary: Enables or disables feed override via P1/P0.

M51.title: Spindle Override Control
M51.description: M51 P1 enables spindle override; M51 P0 disables it. Optional spindle selector $.
M51.summary: Enables or disables spindle speed override for the selected spindle.

M52.title: Adaptive Feed Control
M52.description: Uses motion.adaptive-feed when enabled (e.g. plasma THC).

M53.title: Feed Stop Control
M53.description: When enabled, motion.feed-hold can halt feed when true.
M53.summary: Allows feed-hold to stop motion when the pin is true.

M61.title: Set Current Tool Number
M61.description: M61 Qn sets current tool to n without a physical tool change (e.g. after power-up). Use G43 to apply length offset.
M61.summary: Sets the current tool number without a physical tool change.

M62.title: Digital Output On (Synced)
M62.description: Turns on digital output P at the start of the next motion command.
M62.summary: Turns digital output P on at the start of the next motion.

M63.title: Digital Output Off (Synced)
M63.description: Turns off digital output P at the start of the next motion command.
M63.summary: Turns digital output P off at the start of the next motion.

M64.title: Digital Output On (Immediate)
M64.description: Immediate digital output on; not queued with motion.
M64.summary: Turns digital output P on immediately (not synced to motion).

M65.title: Digital Output Off (Immediate)
M65.summary: Turns digital output P off immediately (not synced to motion).

M66.title: Wait on Input
M66.description: Waits for digital or analog input event with mode L and timeout Q. Result in #5399.
M66.summary: Waits for a digital or analog input event; result in #5399.

M67.title: Analog Output (Synced)
M67.description: Sets analog output E to value Q at the next motion.
M67.summary: Sets analog output E to Q at the next motion.

M68.title: Analog Output (Immediate)
M68.description: Sets analog output E to Q immediately.
M68.summary: Sets analog output E to Q immediately.

M70.title: Save Modal State
M70.description: Saves G/M modal state at current call level for later M72 restore.
M70.summary: Saves modal G/M state at this call level for M72 restore.

M71.title: Invalidate Saved Modal State
M71.description: Invalidates the last M70/M73 save at this level.
M71.summary: Invalidates the last M70/M73 save at this level.

M72.title: Restore Modal State
M72.summary: Restores modal state saved with M70.

M73.title: Save Modal State (Auto-Restore)
M73.description: Saves state and restores it on subroutine return or endsub.
M73.summary: Saves modal state and auto-restores on subroutine return/endsub.

M98.title: Call Subprogram
M98.description: Fanuc-style subprogram call (see Fanuc-Style Programs in the manual).
M98.summary: Calls a Fanuc-style subprogram (see O-code / Fanuc programs).

M99.title: Return from Subprogram
M99.description: Returns from Fanuc-style subprogram or repeats main program depending on usage.
M99.summary: Returns from a subprogram or repeats the main program per usage.
